abstract: McKinsey Global Institute analysis estimates that generative AI could automate 25-40% of time spent on creative tasks, potentially transforming the economics of content production. The research examines how AI capabilities may reshape creative work processes and labor requirements across industries.
keyFindings: Generative AI could automate 25-40% of time spent on creative tasks
Automation of creative tasks would fundamentally change the economics of content production
qualifiers: Limited excerpt provided; full scope and methodology details unavailable from source text. Ranges provided (25-40%) suggest preliminary estimates rather than precise figures.
